name: Nicole Barnes
source:
Nicole Barnes hates being dead. No one would like it, obviously, but after over a hundred years of this bullshit, she's determined to put a stop to it. Yeah, she's had her fun possessing women and making them squirm, but she wants something more... finite. You know, until death do they part.

When she meets Aurora, Nicole sees her escape—and her final victim.

[From [url=https://sapphicore.itch.io/possessed-by-fate]official profile[/url]]
